  How to Submit Public Comment

  Members of the Public who wish to submit public comment may do so using one of
  the following methods. Public comment is limited to the time allotted.

  In-Person: Complete a Speaker Card, indicating the agenda item number and
  submit it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. Speakers shall be limited to three (3)
  minutes per person per item. At the Mayor’s discretion, the time limit may be
  shortened to allow all speakers to address the City Council.

  Website: Electronic submission of Public Comment is available via the online public
  comment form at Public Comment. Public Comment submitted electronically by
  4:00 P.M. on the meeting day will be forwarded to the City Council before the
  meeting for their consideration, but will not be read during the meeting. Comments
  submitted after 4:00 P.M. will be forwarded to Council but may not be received
  before the meeting.

  Watch the Meeting Online

City Council Special Meeting Agenda – May 8, 2025  1
   City Council Special Meeting Agenda
  Thursday, May 8, 2025

  •  CALL TO ORDER
  •  ROLL CALL: Mayor Menchaca, Vice Mayor Chan, Council Members Ding, Herrera
  Avila, Wu

  1. PUBLIC COMMENT

  2. INTERVIEWS AND APPOINTMENTS COMMUNITY SERVICES COMMISSION
  The City solicited applications for the Community Services Commission for three
  positions with two-year terms from June 1, 2025 through May 23, 2027; and one one-
  year term ending May 31, 2026. The Council is requested to conduct interviews and
  consider appointments to the Commission at the conclusion of the interviews.

  Recommendation:

  Staff recommends that the City Council:
  1.  At the conclusion of the interviews, appoint three Commissioners to the
  Community Services Commissions for two-year terms ending May 31, 2027; and

  2.  Appoint a Commissioner to the Community Services Commission to fill an
  unexpired term ending May 31, 2026.

  3. ADJOURNMENT
  The next regular City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, May 20, 2025, at
  6:30 P.M. Information regarding matters to be considered at each meeting will be
  available on the Friday before the City Council Meeting on the City’s website at
  www.sangabrielcity.com.

Materials Available for Inspection. You may view agenda items online at
www.sangabrielcity.com/agendacenter, or in person at City Hall, 425 South Mission Drive,
San Gabriel, CA 91776. Materials related to an item on this Agenda, submitted to the City
Council after distribution of the Agenda packet, will be posted on the City website.

Persons with Disabilities
Upon request, this Agenda will be made available in appropriate alternative formats to
persons with disabilities, as required by Section 202 of the Americans with Disabilities Act
of 1990.

Persons Requesting a Translator
Any person requesting translation for the meeting must notify the City Clerk Department
at cityclerk@sgch.org at least 48 hours before the meeting.

MINUTES OF MAY 8, 2025
  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Menchaca called the special meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at 5:36 P.M.
  on Thursday, May 8, 2025, in the Council Chamber at City Hall, 425 South Mission Drive, San
  Gabriel, California, 91776.

  ROLL CALL

  Council Members Present:  Tony Ding, Jorge Herrera Avila, John Wu, Vice Mayor
  Eric Chan, and Mayor Denise Menchaca
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  Assistant City Attorney Martin Koczanowicz, Community
  Services Assistant Director Matthew Morales-Stevens,
  Assistant City Clerk Marilyn Bonus, and Management
  Assistant Adam Yang.

  1. PUBLIC COMMENT

I  A written comment was received from Chasity Jennings-Nunez in support of
  reappointing incumbents and the appointment of new applicants to the Commission .

  2. INTERVIEWS AND  APPOINTMENTS  TO  THE  COMMUNITY  SERVICES
  COMMISSION

  Interviews with the following applicants were conducted:

  Community Services Commission
  • Nancy Duong
  • Jacky Lau
  • Davis Barrantes

  RECESS AND RECONVENE

  The meeting was recessed at 6:24 P.M. and reconvened at 6:29 P.M. with all Council
  Members present.

I  Interviews with the following applicants were conducted:

  •  Wendy Wang
  •  Aissa Cano
  •  Mary Huang
  •  Cheryl Cabot

  The City Council voted on appointments as follows:
